advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.title: Reliability Excellence Coach
advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. Summary: The Reliability Excellence Coach integrates our maintenance operating system on site at client facilities, working hands‑on with plant leadership and frontline teams to drive measurable behavioral change. This role leads assessments, coaching, change management, and adoption tracking during 8–12 week deployments and contributes to the continuous improvement of our operating system and tools. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: · Embeds at client facilities to drive adoption of the maintenance operating system across all levels of the organization. · Coaches on-site maintenance leadership on process adherence, metrics review cadences, and team behaviors. · Conducts structured walkthroughs and gap assessments against the operating system standard. · Facilitates daily/weekly management routines (tier meetings, KPI reviews, PM compliance huddles). · Identifies and escalates adoption barriers to ATS leadership, including behavioral, organizational, or technical. · Tracks leading and lagging reliability indicators across assigned sites (PM compliance, wrench time, MTTR, backlog aging, etc.). · Prepares and delivers site progress reports for client. · Maintains accurate deployment logs, coaching records, and milestone documentation. · Contributes to the refinement of internal playbooks, onboarding materials, and training content. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs), & Competencies: Essential KSAs: · Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of manufacturing operations experience or equivalent combination of education and experience. · Direct experience in a supervisory, or lead role. · Exposure to maintenance or reliability functions (PM programs, CMMS, RCA, work order management). · Experience operating within a structured maintenance environment. · Ability to travel 40-60% of the time. Desirable KSAs: · Previous experience implementing maintenance programs. · TPM, RCM or Lean maintenance experience. · Thorough understanding of the industrial maintenance environment. Competencies: · Strong Floor Presence · Data Literate · Communication · Self Directed · Change Management Physical Demands and Working Conditions: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb, ascend/descend or balance to heights that may require a ladder or lift; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl in confined spaces; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. The employee is regularly required to use close vision and color vision. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions and risk of electrical shock. Work is typically performed in a factory environment and is usually very loud. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors. ATS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment to all applicants and employees without regard to age, color, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or other legally protected status. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Resident Chef at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by leading high-performing culinary teams that inspire customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. This position leads engaging cooking classes, fostering an enthusiastic and knowledgeable team and overseeing the success of the in-store culinary program. This role requires a blend of culinary talent, business acumen, and teaching skills to drive sales, enhance customer #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and build a high-performing culinary team. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Recruit, mentor and retain a high-performing team to meet the business needs of both culinary and retail. · Lead, coach, and inspire associates to exceed performance expectations and uphold a positive team culture. · Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide feedback, and create development plans to support individual and team growth. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Ensures an outstanding cooking class experience in every session by following provided recipes and game plans while holding employees accountable for quality and execution. · Work with store leadership to increase foot traffic and store engagement through cooking classes and private events. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. · Oversees, addresses, and takes responsibility for all customer feedback related to the culinary program to maintain satisfaction and loyalty. Sales & Business Performance · Drive sales growth by developing and implementing strategies to enhance the culinary and retail business. · Analyze key performance metrics daily and leverage insights to optimize store performance. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary and retail goals by delivering exceptional classes and customer experiences that drive engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail product sales, individual sales volume, average transaction value, customer conversion rates, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Operations & Compliance · Manage daily store operations while ensuring compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Maintains the accuracy and integrity of employee records, including but not limited to time and attendance data, food safety certifications, and personal information. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:fba5d280-d5f.title: Assistant to the CEO
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:fba5d280-d5f.description: About the Role We are looking for an Executive Assistant to act as a strategic right hand to our CEO. This is not a typical administrative position. Beyond handling calendar management and travel coordination in a fast-paced, chaotic environment, you will play an active role in research, analysis, and shaping the organization, as well as act as an "all round" aide to the CEO. We need a clear-thinking, proactive problem solver who can jump right in without needing hand-holding. You will analyze data, build reports, identify operational gaps, and bring solutions to the table before issues arise. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive Operations & Gatekeeping Act as the primary point of contact and buffer for the CEO, managing internal and external communications with tact and judgment. Maintain complete situational awareness of the CEO’s priorities, deadlines, and ongoing projects. Manage complex, fluid calendars across multiple time zones, adjusting dynamically to continuous travel schedule changes. Handle international travel arrangements, itineraries, paperwork, and logistics. 2. Data Analysis & Business Intelligence Gather data across departments to create clear, actionable executive reports, dashboards, and presentations. Continuously audit workflows and metrics to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and areas for process improvement. Conduct research and synthesize complex information into quick, digestible briefs for decision-making. Perform analysis using LLMs, spreadsheets, your own critical thinking & research. 3. Financial & Administrative Support Assist with financial tracking, expense management, budget auditing, and financial reporting. Monitor key financial indicators and track cross-departmental deliverables to ensure projects remain on budget and on schedule. Handle confidential business and financial information with high discretion. 4. Aide & Personal Support Making bookings, find service providers online and in person Requirements & Qualifications Turnkey Capability: Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief Of Staff, Business Operations Manager, or Strategic Coordinator. You can drop into a fast-moving environment on Day 1 without requiring extensive training. High IQ & Analytical Thinking: Exceptional logic and problem-solving ability. You don't just report data; you understand what the numbers mean and recommend action. Proactive & Autonomous: You anticipate needs before they are voiced and actively look for ways to lighten the CEO's operational load. Chaos Tolerance: High adaptability, mental resilience, and composure in fast-changing, high-pressure environments. Financial Literacy: Comfort with numbers, spreadsheets, financial statements, and basic business finance principles. Time Zone Agility: Willingness and technical setup to work evening/night shifts as needed. Some work may be required to be performed in the afternoon, some at night time. Tech Savvy: Advanced proficiency in modern workspace tools (e.g., Claude, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Excel/Google Sheets, project management platforms). Language skills: Ability to speak English fluently, preferred knowledge of both Cantonese and Mandarin as well. Willingness to Travel: Certain work or tasks may be required to be performed physically in Hong Kong or Shenzhen on occasion. Yau are allowed to live and work anywhere in Hong Kong or Guangdong Province for this role.

Expert-level proficiency in at least one major design tool, such as Figma, Adobe Photoshop, or Canva, with the ability to work quickly without compromising quality. Proven ability to produce high volumes of creative and develop 10 or more variations of a successful concept efficiently. Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, layout, color contrast, hooks, CTAs, and other principles used to encourage user action. Experience creating static paid-social advertisements, particularly images and carousels designed for measurable performance. Strong creative judgment and the ability to adapt visual styles to different audiences, products, platforms, and campaign objectives. Ability to interpret performance feedback and translate it into actionable creative iterations. Experience with DTC or UGC-style advertising is highly desirable. Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating static paid-social or performance-media work, including examples of creative hooks, winning concepts, and iterative variations. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6b30b094-f839-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will own the product lifecycle from discovery and roadmap definition through continuous iteration and improvement. A major part of the role involves building trusted client relationships from initial conversations through long-term partnerships. You’ll translate business requirements into clear product direction while collaborating closely with developers and AI-assisted tools. The position combines product strategy, stakeholder management, consultative communication, and account growth. You’ll work within a highly distributed international environment alongside professionals across multiple countries and time zones. This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership while enjoying significant flexibility over where and how you work. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end, including discovery, product strategy, roadmap definition, prioritization, delivery, and iteration based on client, user, and market feedback. Lead client interactions from initial discussions and onboarding through ongoing account management, building relationships that support long-term partnerships. Collaborate with engineers and AI-assisted tools to define solutions, clarify requirements, and support effective product delivery. Build prototypes and contribute to product strategy, helping stakeholders visualize solutions and align around product direction. Communicate product value in a consultative manner by educating and advising clients rather than relying on a transactional sales approach. Proactively engage existing accounts to identify issues early, manage expectations, gather feedback, and uncover opportunities for renewal and expansion. Develop strong, trusted relationships that contribute to retention, account growth, and referrals. Collect, evaluate, and prioritize feedback from clients, users, internal stakeholders, and market signals to continuously improve the product roadmap. Bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring product priorities and business objectives remain aligned throughout the development process. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with demonstrated experience defining roadmaps, managing backlogs, prioritizing features, and working with development teams. Proven experience in a client-facing role involving business development, sales, account management, or consultative relationship building. Demonstrated ability to retain and grow customer accounts over time, rather than focusing solely on new business acquisition. Strong client relationship-building skills and a consultative, customer-first approach. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex product concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Native or near-native proficiency in spoken and written English. Experience building prototypes and translating early-stage ideas into actionable product strategies and requirements. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and incorporating emerging technologies into product development workflows. Ability to work independently and effectively within a fully distributed, international team across multiple time zones. Strong organizational skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to balance competing priorities. A proactive, relationship-oriented mindset with a strong focus on long-term customer success. Nice to have: Previous sales experience, particularly in a consultative environment. Nice to have: Experience working directly with clients in the United States. Benefits:

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f769f150-60a0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Commissioning Project Manager II based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to lead commissioning activities across complex, mission-critical data center development projects. You will act as an owner representative, coordinating technical teams, contractors, vendors, and commissioning partners throughout the project lifecycle. The position plays a central role in ensuring systems are properly tested, documented, and ready for safe and reliable operation. You will lead Level 3, Level 4, and Integrated Systems Testing while managing risks, deficiencies, retesting, and turnover requirements. The role combines hands-on technical expertise with project leadership, stakeholder management, and operational readiness. You will also contribute to process improvements and mentor less experienced commissioning professionals. This is a remote position with significant travel, offering exposure to highly complex infrastructure and large-scale projects. Independently manage commissioning activities for assigned data center projects, buildings, or major project scopes from planning through closeout. Develop and maintain commissioning plans, schedules, testing strategies, issue logs, turnover plans, and supporting documentation. Coordinate commissioning requirements across design, construction, project management, operations, vendors, contractors, and third-party commissioning providers. Participate in project and technical meetings to assess readiness, identify risks, monitor schedules, and ensure commissioning requirements remain aligned with project objectives. Lead Level 3, Level 4, and Integrated Systems Testing, serving as the primary commissioning representative during critical testing events. Verify testing is performed according to approved procedures, design requirements, operational expectations, and established standards. Track deficiencies, corrective actions, retesting requirements, and outstanding issues through resolution, escalating risks or schedule impacts when necessary. Evaluate testing results and provide recommendations concerning operational readiness, project turnover, and startup. Represent the owner's interests throughout commissioning and turnover, holding contractors, vendors, and commissioning providers accountable for quality, schedule, and deliverables. Prepare commissioning reports, executive summaries, progress updates, and status reporting covering testing readiness, risks, issues, and turnover. Manage project closeout and coordinate the collection and review of testing reports, punch lists, operating manuals, warranties, as-built drawings, spare parts inventories, occupancy documentation, and other turnover materials. Ensure commissioning records and closeout packages are accurate, complete, organized, and available to operations teams. Facilitate a smooth transition from commissioning into operational ownership. Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and best-practice sharing to less experienced commissioning professionals. Contribute to continuous improvement of commissioning processes, tools, standards, documentation, and team practices. Requirements: 5–8 years of experience in commissioning, construction management, mission-critical facilities, facility operations, startup, testing, project management, or a related technical discipline. Demonstrated experience independently managing commissioning, testing, startup, turnover, or operational-readiness activities for complex facilities. Strong working knowledge of mechanical, electrical, controls, and other critical infrastructure systems. Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, commissioning plans, operating sequences, test procedures, and technical documentation.
